# Phone-as-Coach — Design Specification

*Amends `docs/design/Sherpaa_DesignSpec.md` for the Phone-as-Coach / Strava Reconciliation amendment (docs/amendments/PhoneAsCoach_Amendment.md).*
*Generated by Stencil | 2026-05-22*

This spec covers all five flows touched by the amendment:

- **Flow A** — Post-Ride Summary with Strava Reconciliation (approved in prior session — included here for completeness)
- **Flow B** — History tab with four-state badges + pull-to-refresh reconciler
- **Flow C** — Debrief-Only Onboarding (Home CTA + DebriefPicker + synthetic ride summary)
- **Flow D** — Settings reframe
- **Flow E** — Launch-Time Reconciliation visible surfaces

The base DesignSpec governs everything not explicitly changed here. Reuse all existing tokens, components, and motion rules. The only net-new color tokens are `imported`, `importedDim`, `importedBorder` — already added to `src/constants/colors.ts`.

---

## Design Intent (why this amendment looks the way it does)

The amendment turns the phone from "the recorder" into "the coach." Visually, this means three things:

1. **The badge is the protagonist of the new UI surface.** Across PostRideSummary, History, and (rarely) Settings, the rider's mental model of "where did this data come from?" is carried by one component — `SyncStateBadge` — in four flavors. Consistency of that one component across surfaces is more important than any single screen's polish.

2. **Phone-recorded is not an error.** A phone-only rider sees the "Phone-recorded" badge on every ride forever. The visual treatment must read as *informational and neutral* — same restraint as a timestamp — not as "missing" or "broken." Gray dot, not red, not amber. No "retry" energy. Just a label.

3. **Imported has its own color.** A Debrief-Only ride did not happen with Sherpaa coaching. It is a real artifact in history but a different kind of artifact. Blue (`#4DA3FF`) is the deliberate departure — distinct from gold (achievement) and green (live-ride synced) — so the rider can tell at a glance that "this one I imported to hear" vs "this one I rode with the voice in my ear." We resisted putting it in gold; we resisted hiding it. We made it readable.

---

## New Color Tokens

Added to `src/constants/colors.ts`:

```
imported:       #4DA3FF    // Imported badge text + dot
importedDim:    rgba(77,163,255,0.10)   // Imported badge bg / Debrief CTA card bg
importedBorder: rgba(77,163,255,0.22)   // Imported badge border / Debrief CTA card border
```

Contrast: `imported` on `bg` (#1C1C1E) = 6.1:1 WCAG AA. On `bgDeep` (#111111) = 6.9:1.

Reuse: the same three tokens style both the `SyncStateBadge` "Imported" state and the `DebriefCTACard` on Home. The semantic link is intentional — the Debrief CTA *produces* Imported rides, so they share a visual family.

---

## SyncStateBadge — Component Spec (the spine of this amendment)

A single inline pill component used on PostRideSummary header, every History row, and (in Settings only as a static legend example, not interactive) the disclosure body.

### Props

```ts
type SyncState = 'awaiting' | 'synced' | 'phone-recorded' | 'imported';

interface SyncStateBadgeProps {
  state: SyncState;
  // Optional size — most surfaces use 'sm'. PostRideSummary header uses 'md'.
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
}
```

### Visual states

All four states share: 999px radius, inline pill, 1px border, leading dot or 12px spinner, label text.

| State | Dot / Icon | Label | Bg | Border | Text |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `awaiting` | 12px gold spinner (small ActivityIndicator) | "Awaiting Strava…" | `goldDim` | `goldBorder` | `gold` |
| `synced` | 8px green dot with ✓ inset (or just dot at sm) | "Synced from Strava" | `successDim` | `successBorder` | `success` |
| `phone-recorded` | 8px gray dot (`textMuted`) | "Phone-recorded" | `surfaceAlt` | `borderSubtle` | `textSecondary` |
| `imported` | 8px blue dot (`imported`) | "Imported" | `importedDim` | `importedBorder` | `imported` |

### Sizes

- `sm` (History rows, History list cards): height 22px · paddingH 8px · gap between dot and label 6px · label 11px / 600 / letterSpacing 0.3
- `md` (PostRideSummary header): height 28px · paddingH 12px · gap 8px · label 13px / 600 / letterSpacing 0.2

### Behavior

- **Pure presentational.** Decides nothing — parent passes `state`. The component does not poll, fetch, or know about `dataSource`. Mapping `dataSource` + `importedFromStrava` + reconcilerActive → `SyncState` happens in the screen, not the badge.
- **Animation on state change:** when `state` transitions (e.g., `awaiting` → `synced`), the badge cross-fades: the outgoing pill fades to 0 opacity over 150ms while the incoming pill fades from 0 to 1 over 200ms, with 50ms overlap. No scale change. No layout shift — both badges occupy the same width band, achieved by sizing the container to the wider of the two labels at mount (use `minWidth` calculated from the longer of the two visible labels for the screen's lifecycle).
- **Reduced Motion:** when `prefers-reduced-motion` (queried via `AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled`), no cross-fade — instant swap.

### Accessibility

- `accessibilityRole="text"` (not "button" — it is not interactive)
- `accessibilityLabel` per state:
  - awaiting: "Sync status: waiting for Strava activity"
  - synced: "Sync status: Strava authoritative data"
  - phone-recorded: "Sync status: recorded on this phone"
  - imported: "Sync status: imported Strava ride"
- On state change announces the new label via `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility`.

### State table (badge × affordance × microcopy)

| `dataSource` | `importedFromStrava` | Strava token | Reconciler active? | Badge | Affordance | Per-segment microcopy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| provisional | false | present | yes | `awaiting` | — | `via GPS · provisional` |
| provisional | false | present | no, terminal | `phone-recorded` | "Check again" link | `via GPS · provisional` |
| provisional | false | absent | n/a | `phone-recorded` | "Connect Strava to verify…" (first-time only) | `via GPS · provisional` |
| strava | false | present | n/a | `synced` | "Wrong activity?" | `via Strava` |
| strava | true | present | n/a | `imported` | — (no remap; user picked it) | `via Strava` |

### Upgrade choreography (when reconciler resolves in-screen)

Triggered when `dataSource` flips from `provisional` to `strava` on a focused PostRideSummary:

1. **t=0ms** — Badge cross-fade begins: `awaiting` → `synced` (per SyncStateBadge animation).
2. **t=80ms** — Stat numbers count-up animate to new values. Distance, duration, elevation, avg W, avg BPM each animate independently using `Animated.timing` with `duration: 600ms`, `easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)`. Number text uses `tabular-nums` so digits don't jitter. If a stat is unchanged, no animation.
3. **t=120ms** — Per-segment effort times cross-fade: each segment row's time text fades to 30% opacity (150ms), updates value, fades back to 100% (200ms). Microcopy under the time swaps from `via GPS · provisional` to `via Strava` in the same animation.
4. **t=300ms** — Haptic: `Haptics.selectionAsync()` (single light tick) — confirms the change without celebration. The PR moment already happened on the result screen; this is just data resolution.
5. **t=400ms** — Affordance row updates: any "Check again" link removes itself with a 150ms fade; "Wrong activity?" link fades in (only if `!importedFromStrava`).

No celebration animation. No toast. No sound. The amendment's whole point is that Strava data arriving is normal, not eventful.

### Edge cases & error states

- **Strava token expires mid-reconciliation** → badge stays `awaiting` for the rest of the screen lifecycle; on Done, reconciler is stopped silently. On next foreground, launch-time reconciler retries with refreshed token. No error UI on PostRideSummary.
- **"Check again" tapped while screen already polling** → no-op visually; tap registers a haptic (`Haptics.selectionAsync()`) so the user knows the tap landed.
- **"Check again" returns no match** → label shows transient "No match yet" in `textMuted` for 2 seconds, then reverts.
- **"Check again" returns error** → label shows "Couldn't reach Strava" in `error` color for 3 seconds, then reverts.
- **"Wrong activity?" tapped** → opens `WrongActivityChooser` modal (bottom sheet).
- **PostRideSummary opened in `historyMode` from History tab** → identical layout; reconciler does NOT start on mount for `dataSource='strava'` rides. Reconciler DOES start for `provisional` rides being viewed from history (gives user a manual "Check again" surface).

### WrongActivityChooser — bottom sheet modal

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [PostRideSummary scrim at 50% opacity]  │
│                                         │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │ ─── handle 36×4 borderStrong ────   ││
│  │                                     ││
│  │  Pick the right activity            ││
│  │  (20/700 textPrimary)               ││
│  │  Sorted by closest start time to your ride. │
│  │  (13/400 textMuted)                 ││
│  │                                     ││
│  │  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐││
│  │  │ ● Morning Ride                  │││  ← gold dot = currently mapped
│  │  │   8:04 AM · 48.1 km · 2h 14m   │││
│  │  └─────────────────────────────────┘││

│  │  └─────────────────────────────────┘││
│  │  [up to 10 candidate activities]    ││
│  │                                     ││
│  │  ────────────────────────────────   ││
│  │  None of these — unmap              ││  ← destructive btn-ghost
│  │  (15/600 error)                     ││
│  │  [paddingBottom: safeArea.bottom+24]││

└─────────────────────────────────────────┘

Sheet: bgOverlay (#1A1A1A) bg, 24px top radius, borderSubtle top border.
Row: 14px vertical padding, 1px borderSubtle bottom divider.
Currently-mapped row: gold dot, gold name color, surrounding row bg = goldDim.
```

Tapping a row: closes sheet (300ms spring slide-down), kicks off `remapRideToActivity` in service, PostRideSummary re-renders via SQLite re-read. Upgrade choreography fires again because numbers may have changed.

Haptic: `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)` on row tap; `Haptics.notificationAsync(Success)` on remap completion; `Haptics.notificationAsync(Warning)` on unmap.

### Accessibility

- "Wrong activity?" link: `accessibilityLabel="Re-map this ride to a different Strava activity"`, `accessibilityHint="Opens a list of recent Strava activities"`
- "Check again" link: `accessibilityLabel="Check again for a matching Strava activity"`
- Per-segment microcopy: included in row's `accessibilityLabel` — e.g. "Hawk Hill, 4 minutes 8 seconds, from Strava"
- Modal: `accessibilityViewIsModal={true}` on iOS; trap focus on Android

│  └─────────────────────────────────────┘│

├─────────────────────────────────────────┤

└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### State table (badge selection per ride row)

| Ride state | Badge shown |
|---|---|
| `data_source='provisional'` AND reconciler attempted < 5 min ago in current session | `awaiting` (carry-over from PostRideSummary or pull-to-refresh) |
| `data_source='provisional'` AND no active reconciler | `phone-recorded` |
| `data_source='strava'` AND `importedFromStrava=false` | `synced` |
| `data_source='strava'` AND `importedFromStrava=true` | `imported` |

In practice 95%+ of List rows render `synced`, `phone-recorded`, or `imported` — `awaiting` only flashes during the moments after pull-to-refresh while the launch reconciler is running.

### Subtitle copy logic

- 0 provisional rides: `"{N} rides"` (or `"{N} ride"`)
- ≥1 provisional rides where rider has a Strava token: `"{N} rides · {P} awaiting Strava"`
- ≥1 provisional rides where rider has NO Strava token (phone-only Priya forever): `"{N} rides"` — the "awaiting" count is dishonest if there's no way it will ever reconcile. Just don't show it.

This matters: the phone-only rider must never see numeric pressure ("3 awaiting Strava") for rides that will never reconcile. The audit at the boundary (Strava token present?) is the answer.

### Pull-to-refresh behavior

- `RefreshControl` tintColor: `gold`
- On pull-release: light haptic + `setRefreshing(true)`
- Two operations fire in parallel:
  1. `loadRideHistory()` re-read from SQLite (returns immediately, < 50ms)
  2. `reconcileOnLaunch(accessToken)` — gated to max 5 rides per pull, throttled by `rateBudget.ts`
- Spinner persists until BOTH complete OR 8 seconds elapses (timeout — don't punish the user for slow Strava)
- On reconcile success: any rides whose `data_source` flipped to `strava` re-render with their new badge. **No animation** at the History row level — the row simply re-renders. The choreography is reserved for the focused PostRideSummary screen; in a list, animated badge changes across multiple rows would be visually noisy.
- On reconcile failure (network, rate limit): silent. The pull-to-refresh spinner simply ends. No error toast in MVP. Logged for debug.
- Subtitle "{N} rides · {P} awaiting Strava" updates if `P` changed.

### Edge cases & errors

- **Pull-to-refresh while offline** → SQLite re-read still runs; reconciler call fails fast on first ride, others are skipped. Spinner dismisses normally. No error UI.
- **0 rides in history** → empty state per existing DesignSpec: "No rides yet. Your completed rides will appear here." Pull-to-refresh is still active (lets the user verify the app is alive).
- **Tapping a ride row** → navigate to `Ride/PostRideSummary` with `{rideId, historyMode: true}`. Slide-left 300ms spring per default push.
- **Tapping a `phone-recorded` row** → opens PostRideSummary in historyMode; reconciler starts on mount (gives "Check again" affordance). Tapping `synced` or `imported` opens PostRideSummary in historyMode without starting reconciler.

### Haptics

- Pull-to-refresh release: `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)`
- Row tap: `Haptics.selectionAsync()` (default tab system tap)
- Reconciliation completes with ≥1 ride upgraded: no haptic. (Background work — surprise haptic would be jarring.)

### Accessibility

- Row `accessibilityLabel`: full sentence including badge state, e.g. "Morning Ride, April 11, 48.2 kilometers, 2 hours 14 minutes, 4 segments, 1 PR. Sync status: Strava authoritative data. Tap to view details."
- Pull-to-refresh: platform-native VoiceOver/TalkBack
- Subtitle "1 awaiting Strava": `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"` on Android — announces if the count changes after pull-to-refresh

### Transition

```
→ TRANSITION: Home/Segs/Settings → History
   Trigger: Tab bar tap
   Animation: Cross-fade 200ms (tab switch is not directional)
   Back gesture: n/a (tab)

→ TRANSITION: History → PostRideSummary (history mode)
   Trigger: Row tap
   Animation: Slide left 300ms spring (tension 100, friction 20)
   Duration: 300ms
   Back gesture: Swipe right (iOS) / system back (Android) — pop to History
```

│                                         │

```

### DebriefCTACard — spec

- Bg: `importedDim` · Border: 1px `importedBorder` · Radius: 12px · Padding: 16px H × 14px V · MinHeight: 72px
- Layout: 40×40 icon wrapper (left) + title/sub stack (center, flex:1) + chevron `›` (right, `textMuted`, 22px)
- Icon wrapper: 40×40, 999px radius, `importedDim` bg (slightly stronger via opacity? — keep at importedDim, the contrast comes from the icon itself), `importedBorder` border. Icon glyph: musical note `♪` in `imported` (28px). TODO: replace with proper waveform SVG.
- Title: 16/700 `textPrimary`
- Subtitle: 13/400 `textSecondary` · lineHeight 18
- Active opacity on press: 0.8 · Haptic on press: `Haptics.selectionAsync()`

**Prominence logic:**
- **Brand-new user with 0 rides:** DebriefCTACard renders at the same visual weight as Plan Ride card (both surface-level, both 72px+ tall). They are siblings.
- **Returning user with ≥1 ride:** DebriefCTACard stays present but visually de-emphasized — its `importedDim` background is muted enough that the eye still tracks to Plan Ride first. No JS-level prominence change needed; the visual hierarchy is handled by color alone.

### DebriefPicker screen

Route: `Ride/DebriefPicker`. Pushed from Home with slide-left 300ms.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│▓▓▓▓▓ STATUS BAR ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ←  (44×44 surface bg)                  │
│                                         │
│  Pick a ride to hear debriefed.         │
│  (24/700 textPrimary, letterSpacing:-0.4)│
│  Last 10 Strava activities.             │
│  (13/400 textSecondary)                 │
│  Updated 14m ago                        │  ← staleness label, mirrors RouteSetup
│  (13/500 textMuted) — hidden if <30m    │
│                                         │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │ Morning Climb to Grizzly            ││
│  │ Apr 11 · 42.1 km · 2h 14m           ││  ← reuses RouteSetup activity row pattern
│  └─────────────────────────────────────┘│
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │ Paradise Loop recovery              ││
│  │ Apr 9 · 28.4 km · 1h 02m           ││
│  └─────────────────────────────────────┘│
│  ...                                    │
│                                         │
│  [Pull-to-refresh — gold spinner,       │
│   bypasses 4h activity TTL]             │
│                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│▓▓▓▓ HOME INDICATOR ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Background: `bg`. No map (intentional — keep it simple, this is a list).
- Row: 16px H × 14px V padding, `surface` bg, 12px radius, 1px `border`, 10px bottom margin between cards
- Row name: 16/600 `textPrimary`; meta: 13/400 `textSecondary`
- Activeopacity on press: 0.7
- **No selection state** — tap immediately triggers fetch + navigate, no "confirm" button. This is a 30-second loop; gating it with a confirm step would kill the value.

### States

- **Loading (first mount, no cached activities)**: full-screen centered `ActivityIndicator` size="large" color=`gold`, label "Loading your Strava rides…" 13/500 `textSecondary` below.
- **Empty state**: surface card, 200px tall, centered:
  > "No recent Strava rides found."
  > "Pull down to refresh, or wait until your next ride syncs."
  > 14/500 `textSecondary`, centered
- **Network failure on first load**: same empty-state container with text "Couldn't reach Strava." + "Try Again" btn-outline 44px tall.
- **Loading after row tap (fetching activity detail)**: row that was tapped shows a small inline `ActivityIndicator` (gold, "small") to the right of the chevron. Other rows remain interactive but the screen-level "now navigating" is signaled. On fetch complete (~1–3s typical), navigate. On fetch failure, inline spinner replaced with a 13/500 `error` "Couldn't load — tap to retry" inline.

### Transition to PostRideSummary in history mode

```
→ TRANSITION: DebriefPicker → PostRideSummary (synthetic ride, history mode)
   Trigger: Row tap, after activity detail fetch resolves
   Animation: Slide left 300ms spring
   Back gesture: Swipe right pops to DebriefPicker (NOT to Home — user might want another)
```

On PostRideSummary mount in this mode:
- Badge state: `imported` (because the synthetic ride is persisted with `importedFromStrava=true`, `dataSource='strava'`)
- Debrief auto-speaks once on mount, same as live-ride debrief
- "Wrong activity?" affordance: hidden (rider chose this activity deliberately)
- "Check again" affordance: hidden (already strava-authoritative)
- "Listen to Debrief Again" and "Done" CTAs: present, identical to live-ride PostRideSummary
- "Done" pops back to DebriefPicker (NOT Home) — user can immediately pick another to hear
- The synthetic ride is now in SQLite and will appear in History with an `imported` badge

### Edge cases

- **Strava not connected (no token)**: from Home, tapping DebriefCTACard navigates to StravaConnect flow first; on success, navigates to DebriefPicker. (Don't bury this — phone-only Priya needs the Strava connection just to use this feature.)
- **0 starred segments on the chosen ride**: the debrief speaker has logic to fall back to a generic narrative ("17 km in 52 minutes, no starred segments on this route — try a route with some climbs next time"). PostRideSummary's Segments section renders an empty state: "No starred segments on this route" in `textMuted` italic, no segment rows.
- **Activity detail fetch fails after row tap**: stay on DebriefPicker; row shows inline error per above.

### Haptics

- DebriefCTACard tap: `Haptics.selectionAsync()`
- Activity row tap: `Haptics.selectionAsync()`
- Pull-to-refresh release: `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)`
- Navigate to PostRideSummary: no additional haptic (the speak-on-mount provides the experiential payoff)

### Accessibility

- DebriefCTACard `accessibilityRole="button"`, label: "Hear a past ride debriefed. 60-second voice summary of any Strava ride."
- DebriefPicker rows: `accessibilityLabel="Morning Climb to Grizzly. April 11. 42.1 kilometers, 2 hours 14 minutes. Tap to hear debrief."`
- Loading indicator: `accessibilityLabel="Loading your Strava rides"`

### DisclosureRow — expanded state

- Inset body bg: `surfaceAlt` (#242424), 8px radius, 12px H × 12px V padding, 8px margin inset from row borders
- Body text: 13/400 `textSecondary`, lineHeight: 19
- Chevron rotation: `Animated.timing` over 200ms, ease-in-out
- Expand height: `LayoutAnimation.configureNext({duration: 250, update: {type: 'easeInEaseOut'}})` — natural height
- Default state: collapsed. Choice persists for session only (re-collapses on app cold launch — this is informational, not a setting).

### Reconnect Strava row

- Pressable (chevron `›`), same row pattern as existing Pressable
- Tap: navigates to `StravaConnect` screen (push), preserving back stack so a swipe-back returns to Settings
- Useful when: token revoked, user wants to switch accounts, debugging

### What was removed (visible diff from current Settings)

- The `stravaAutoUpload` toggle row, its label "Auto-upload completed rides", and its sublabel "Sync to Strava when you end a ride" — fully removed from the rendered UI. The store field remains for persisted-state safety (no migration needed); it is simply never read or set by any UI.

### Haptics

- DisclosureRow tap: `Haptics.selectionAsync()`
- Reconnect Strava tap: `Haptics.selectionAsync()`

### Accessibility

- DisclosureRow: `accessibilityRole="button"`, `accessibilityState={{expanded: isOpen}}`, label "What gets synced", hint "Double tap to expand"
- Disclosure body: `accessibilityRole="text"`; when expanded, announce contents via `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility` (truncated to first sentence)
- Reconnect Strava: `accessibilityRole="button"`, label "Reconnect Strava", hint "Opens the Strava connection screen"

### Edge cases

- **Strava token expired but refreshable**: no UI change; refresh happens in background on next API call. Settings doesn't expose this.
- **Strava token irrecoverably broken**: "Last activity fetch" shows "Failed — reconnect" in `error` color; tapping Reconnect Strava goes to OAuth.
- **Never connected** (shouldn't happen post-onboarding, but possible after sign-out): "Connected as" row shows "Not connected" in `textMuted`; Reconnect Strava label changes to "Connect Strava"; sync rows show "—".

## Flow E — Launch-Time Reconciliation (visible surfaces)

The reconciler runs invisibly when the user is not viewing a relevant screen. There are exactly three surfaces where the reconciler's resolution becomes *visible*:

### Surface 1 — PostRideSummary (focused in historyMode)

User is viewing a `phone-recorded` ride from History. Reconciler started on mount. After 1–10 seconds, it matches and the ride upgrades.

**Behavior:** Identical to in-session upgrade choreography (badge cross-fade → stat count-up → effort time cross-fade → microcopy swap → light haptic). The "Check again" link fades out; "Wrong activity?" link fades in.

**No additional toast or banner.** The screen content carries the change.

### Surface 2 — History list (focused while reconciler is running in background)

User has just opened the History tab. The launch-time reconciler runs in background. After 1–10 seconds, one or more rows have their `data_source` upgraded.

**Behavior:** No row-level animation. The subtitle "{N} rides · {P} awaiting Strava" updates with a 200ms cross-fade as `P` decreases. The affected rows re-render with their new badge on the next FlatList tick. The visual hierarchy of the list is preserved; no scroll jump.

**Why no row-level animation:** in a scrollable list, animating badges across multiple rows is noise. The subtitle is the single point of truth; the rider can see *that* something changed without each row demanding attention.

### Surface 3 — Home screen (rare — reconciler running while user is on Home)

The launch-time reconciler fires on app foreground, regardless of which tab the user lands on. If the user happens to be on Home (the default landing tab) when a provisional ride upgrades, there is no visible Home surface that displays per-ride sync state — so nothing changes visually on Home. The change becomes visible only when the user navigates to History or PostRideSummary.

**This is intentional.** Surfacing "Hey, your old ride just got reconciled!" on Home would be noise for a user who is mid-flow toward Plan Ride. The change is captured for whenever they look.

### What about "Awaiting Strava…" appearing on a History row?

This is a narrow case. The launch reconciler is running for ride X. The user happens to tap History at exactly that moment. Ride X's row could in principle render as `awaiting`.

**Decision:** During launch-time reconciliation, History rows for provisional rides under active reconcile show the `awaiting` badge instead of `phone-recorded`. The badge cross-fades silently on the row when reconcile finishes (resolved → `synced` OR `imported`; unresolved → `phone-recorded`). This is the one exception to the "no row-level animation" rule, and it is acceptable because at most 5 rows transition (the per-launch cap), and the transition is the badge cross-fade only (no count-up of stats in the list — stats stay numerically what they were until the user opens the row).

### Edge case: app backgrounded mid-reconcile

iOS suspends the JS thread on background. The reconciler's in-flight `fetch` will reject or hang; on next foreground the launch reconciler runs again from scratch. No UI artifact.

---

## Transition & Animation Catalogue (additions to base spec)

| Transition | Animation | Duration | Curve |
|---|---|---|---|
| SyncStateBadge state change | Cross-fade (out 150ms, in 200ms, 50ms overlap) | 250ms total | Ease-in-out |
| Stat number upgrade (PostRideSummary) | Count-up (Animated.timing) | 600ms | Easing.out(cubic) |
| Segment effort time upgrade | Cross-fade text (out 150ms → update → in 200ms) | 350ms | Ease-in-out |
| History subtitle "awaiting" count change | Text cross-fade | 200ms | Ease-in-out |
| DisclosureRow expand/collapse | LayoutAnimation easeInEaseOut | 250ms | Ease-in-out |
| DisclosureRow chevron rotate | Animated.timing 0→90° | 200ms | Ease-in-out |
| WrongActivityChooser bottom sheet rise | Spring from bottom | 300ms | Spring tension 80 friction 18 |
| WrongActivityChooser dismiss | Spring to bottom | 250ms | Spring |
| Home → DebriefPicker | Slide left | 300ms | Spring tension 100 friction 20 |
| DebriefPicker → PostRideSummary (history) | Slide left | 300ms | Spring |

**Reduced Motion:** All cross-fades become instant swaps. Count-up becomes instant value replacement. LayoutAnimation respects the system flag automatically.

---

## Haptics Catalogue (additions)

| Event | Haptic |
|---|---|
| Reconciliation upgrade lands on focused PostRideSummary | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` (single light tick) |
| "Check again" tap | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` |
| "Wrong activity?" tap → modal opens | `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)` |
| WrongActivityChooser row tap | `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)` |
| Remap completion (PostRideSummary re-renders) | `Haptics.notificationAsync(Success)` |
| Unmap (None of these) | `Haptics.notificationAsync(Warning)` |
| DebriefCTACard tap | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` |
| DebriefPicker row tap | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` |
| DisclosureRow toggle | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` |
| Reconnect Strava tap | `Haptics.selectionAsync()` |
| History pull-to-refresh release | `Haptics.impactAsync(Light)` |

**Explicitly no haptic for:** background launch-reconciliation completion (it's background work; a haptic would be a surprise), History row badge update during launch reconciliation (would chain), DebriefCTACard becoming visible on app launch.

---

## Accessibility Summary (additions)

- New `imported` color contrast verified: 6.1:1 on `bg` (#1C1C1E) — WCAG AA pass for normal text, AAA for large text. Sufficient for the 11px badge label given `imported` is also paired with a visible dot icon and an `accessibilityLabel`.
- Reduced Motion: every animation in this amendment has an instant fallback.
- Live regions: History subtitle and per-row badge state changes use `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"` on Android / `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility` on iOS to announce reconciliation results without interrupting reading flow.
- VoiceOver focus management: WrongActivityChooser bottom sheet uses `accessibilityViewIsModal={true}` and traps focus until dismissed. On dismiss, focus returns to the "Wrong activity?" link that opened it.
